entries.en: We look forward to doing business with the Citadel.
Certainly.
It's best if we're not seen talking.
Further contact might make the asari suspicious.
A cracking device. I appreciate your forthrightness, Shepard.
Now that we know what to look for, our IT people can have a little fun with the asari. We'll isolate their viruses and feed them false data.
First, the boilerplate disclaimer. No genetic enhancement is guaranteed to "take." We can maximize the odds, but every strand of DNA is unique.
Our patented techniques can provide an 8% improvement in adrenal response, 12% faster clotting, and a measurable decrease in zee-gee muscle degeneracy.
What? I-- We could try to make the skin insensate, I suppose. Full-body numbness. Atrophy out all the nerve clusters. You'd still feel internal injuries.
But that's dangerously close to genetic engineering, Shepard. The laws only allow improvement of natural functions. We can't add or remove.
It's a first for the industry. The advent of element-zero-based artificial gravity made it a less pressing concern.
We're still waiting for tests to give us an average improvement. We estimate a 7 to 11% decrease in muscle loss rates.
I see you've done some research. That is their official claim.
However, we believe they cherry-picked their sample to show optimum results. The numbers we provide are strict mathematical averages.
Those aren't very large improvements. I suppose every little bit helps.
I'll make sure that's in my report. The bean-counters back at HQ can figure out the details. You know what I'm saying?
How would you distribute the upgrades? Retroviral injections would take some time.
That's the commercial price, for individual purchasers. I'm offering you millions of jobs, Mr. Vargas. That's worth more than some stock sensory upgrades.
Are you sure that's the best price you can offer?
Does Binary Helix have any less-than-above-board projects? I'll keep my source confidential.
If you have any tips, I'd appreciate them. It would reflect well on you and Binary Helix.
If they don't get in my face, I'm not going to dig them out. I'm not here for a random spot-check.
I wear a lot of hats, Mr. Vargas. Some days I shut down criminals. Some days I defuse nukes. Some days I like to enjoy private vices. You understand me?
I'll level with you. I was hired to break into your network. An agent of the Aramali Council gave me this.
Are you calling me a liar, Mr. Vargas?
Maybe I'm personally interested. Ever consider that?
Sounds like my crew needs me for something. I'll be in touch.
I'm sorry, Mr. Vargas. That's a call I have to take. Thank you for your time.
I'm sorry, I have a call coming through. Would you excuse me a moment?
Actually, I wanted to warn you. An agent of the Aramali Council hired me to break into your network. She gave me this.
Is it possible to deaden pain somehow?
I've never heard of a technique that improves zero-gravity endurance.
MarsGene's clotting enhancement improves speed by 16%.
An asari asked me to spy.
What about pain immunity?
Muscle degeneracy?
Not good enough.
Small improvements.
Sounds reasonable.
What about distribution?
Don't rip me off.
That seems high.
You sound guilty.
Know of any?
Not everything I do is legal.
An asari hired me.
Don't question me.
I want to know.
That's my comm unit.
I'm being paged.
We hope to hear from you soon.
I'll get an estimate in writing.
Remember our motto; "A Better Foundation, A Stronger House."
Go on through, Commander.
Access to the garage is restricted.
Yes, that's genuine. Drive safely. The weather's supposed to be pretty bad out in the Aleutsk Valley.
If you want to enter the garage, you need authorization from Mr. Anoleis. No exceptions. Sorry.
Have a good day.
I have authorization. Excuse me.
I'm on Citadel business. I need to leave this station.
Fine, I was just passing by.
I have a pass.
Stand aside.
I have to leave.
What the-- What are these things? Fan out and secure the area! No one gets in or out!
What did you do here, Commander?
The geth ambushed us. We fought back. That's it.
Me? I'm the victim here! The geth attacked us.
Only what I had to. I didn't ask the geth to attack.
I defeated a geth ambush.
I defended myself.
Just business.
Geth? You expect me to-- Where did they come from?
If I were to guess, the Matriarch packed them in the shipping containers she arrived with.
The asari bitch came with a bunch of cargo. They were probably packed in those.
If I were to guess, Benezia packed them in the shipping containers she arrived with.
I do not believe that. We did thorough scans of those. There were no power sources, no element zero masses...
If Benezia-sama's containers were packed with these things, there are many more out there.
Dozens at least. They are machines. You could pack them tightly.
I appreciate that. My people are good, but few of them have combat experience.
For three centuries, everyone has said, "The geth do not come out of the Veil." What is happening out there?
I must report to the Executive Board. If word gets out about loose geth, there may be an investor panic.
I need numbers, Captain. A dozen? A hundred?
We've fought geth before. We'll take care of them for you.
We may be seeing a lot more of these things in the coming months.
How many more?
We'll handle them.
Now you know what to look for.
The same thing that happens to all species, Captain. Evolution.
Safe money says Benezia had them in those shipping containers she arrived with.
Guess we know what the Matriarch had in the crates.
So that's what the asari had in the crates.
I'd say these are what the Matriarch had in the crates.
Guess we know what Benezia had in the crates.
Approach Control, this is the SSV Normandy. Requesting a vector and a berth.
Normandy, your arrival was not scheduled. Our defense grid is armed and tracking you. State your business.
Citadel business. We've got a Council Spectre aboard.
Landing access granted, Normandy.
What a fun bunch. I think I'll take my next leave here.
Be advised: we will be confirming identification on arrival. If confirmation cannot be established, your vessel will be impounded.
